embedding_model.name: intfloat/multilingual-e5-small
embedding_model.reused_from: experiments/duplicate_language_embedding/ (Milestone 2) -- NOT regenerated for this experiment

teacher_model.name: Claude Opus (claude-opus-4-8)
teacher_model.role: independent content-based reviewer for: (a) 180 Objective-A evaluation prompt pairs,
(b) 150 Objective-C cross-domain candidate concept pairs, (c) a 40-concept Objective-D
teacher_model.note: Used strictly as a reviewer of pre-selected candidates with full prompt text in context;
never used to assign labels from cosine similarity alone, and never used as a per-record
classifier over the full 25,000-prompt corpus (that would have been an unjustified
LLM-per-record cost for a task where deterministic/clustering methods sufficed).

clustering_models.hdbscan: 0.8.44 (density-based, no pre-chosen k, native noise/outlier label)
clustering_models.umap: umap-learn 0.6.0 (visualization-only 2D projection, never used for cluster assignment)
